BiblicalUsage: Blessings overtake the one who obeys the voice of the LORD, and David pursues the Amalekites knowing he will overtake them and recover all. The ransomed return to Zion with everlasting joy overtaking them, and the sword of the enemy overtakes those who refuse to turn.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's blessings are not standing still waiting to be found — they chase the obedient down. When I walk in His way, His goodness catches up with me before my trouble does.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
